name: Campfire
summary: A club's ambient campfire under the stars: every log a member tosses (with a line they say) keeps it burning for a few hours and seats their face around it; with nobody adding it burns down to embers. Toss a log and it arcs in and the flames flare; tap the fire to poke it.
useWhen: keep the outing club fire going this week
something cozy for the group while everyone's away on break
a little check-in thing for the club, low effort
a place to drop a line to the group now and then
dontUseWhen: planning an actual camping trip (use trip-lock or bring-list)

hours.description: Hours one log keeps burning, e.g. 6

lines.description: Up to 4 short things to say with a log

said.description: What they said, in their words
